name: Track money and tasks with durable changes
description: Checks real saved records, accurate chart values, validation and persistence.
steps: Sign in and complete onboarding if needed
Open Organize and create a task named QA Call Studio
Mark the task complete and reload to verify it stays complete
Open Money and add two transactions dated today: QA Groceries for 90 in Groceries and QA Transit for 10 in Transportation
Verify the recorded spending increases by 100 and the chart proportions reflect the saved categories
Add a monthly subscription QA Cancelled Plan for 20, cancel it, and verify its amount is excluded from the monthly subscription estimate
Attempt to save a transaction with a negative amount and verify it is rejected
Delete the QA Call Studio task, confirm, and reload
expected: Recorded changes persist, cancelled subscriptions are excluded, invalid amounts do not save, and the confirmed deleted task stays deleted.

name: Approve a focus plan that respects calendar appointments
description: Verifies that planner drafts avoid a real saved appointment and save only on approval.
setup: Create an open task named QA Prepare Lesson
Create a Calendar event named QA Appointment on 2030-01-15 at 09:00
steps: Open Ask Nyx and the Daily focus planner
Set date to 2030-01-15, start to 09:00, hours to 4 and focus minutes to 45
Generate a draft schedule and verify no proposed block overlaps 09:00–10:00
Verify no focus event was saved before approval
Approve the first proposed session
Open Calendar and verify the focus session has the approved start time
Reload and verify that session remains
Open Nyx Live and verify the saved event is available
expected: The existing appointment is respected, draft sessions do not save automatically, and one approved session persists with the correct time.

name: Use conversation context and explicitly approve an assistant action
description: Checks useful AI output and a durable action whose approval cannot duplicate it.
steps: Open Ask Nyx and start a New conversation
Ask: Create a task named QA Confirm Private Lesson. Do not save it until I approve
Verify a proposed task appears with Approve & save and Dismiss controls
Verify it is described as a proposal and is not claimed saved
Approve the task and verify Saved is shown instead of an active approve button
Open Organize and verify QA Confirm Private Lesson exists once
Return to Ask Nyx and ask: What task did I just ask you to create?
Verify Nyx refers to the private lesson task using conversation context
Open Smart briefing and generate the saved-data financial snapshot
expected: Nyx provides contextual replies, an explicitly approved task is saved once, and the briefing clearly identifies recorded data rather than a connected bank balance.

name: Back up and restore private records without duplication
description: Verifies the complete backup and repeatable restore workflow with durable private data.
setup: Save a Nyx Memory preference: QA I prefer morning focus sessions
Add a pending Gmail connection request labelled QA Personal Email
steps: Download a backup using Download backup
Inspect the downloaded JSON and verify version 4 plus data, profile, memories and connectionRequests
Restore that downloaded backup and confirm the restore
Verify existing records are reported as already present
Restore the same downloaded backup again and verify record counts do not increase
Verify the saved memory and pending email request remain available
Open Debt and add a 10000 balance debt with 30 APR and zero monthly payment, then set extra monthly payment to zero
Verify the simulator states that payoff is not reached within 50 years rather than presenting a debt-free date
expected: Backups contain profile and memories, repeat restores do not duplicate records, connection requests stay unconnected, and unpayable debt is not shown as paid off.

name: Recover from assistant errors and clear private state on mobile sign-out
description: Verifies a visible AI failure, accessible mobile controls and private-state cleanup.
steps: Sign in and open Ask Nyx through the mobile navigation
Send the message QA Help me plan today
Verify a visible error appears and the message remains available to retry
Open Voice settings and verify Preview voice, neural voice choice and a text alternative are available
Verify the microphone does not start without tapping it
Open Settings and confirm connections are described as pending setup and billing as inactive
Open Receipts and upload a small readable test receipt image with merchant QA Cafe and total 10.00; verify extracted merchant and total are shown
Save the scanned receipt and verify exactly one matching transaction appears in Money
Open More, try Enable notifications, and verify either enabled status or actionable browser/device guidance appears
Lock Novyx now and verify the sign-in screen appears without the previous reply, form content or workspace
Sign in again and verify the previous failed message is not prefilled
expected: The AI failure is visible and retryable, mobile controls remain usable, unconnected capabilities are represented honestly, and signing out clears private in-memory state.
